title: Let Comovo's fit_friends repository use the standard test launcher (it has no scripts/test-launcher.mjs, and TermAl's launcher only tests its own repository)
outcome: Let Comovo's fit_friends repository use the standard test launcher (it has no scripts/test-launcher.mjs, and TermAl's launcher only tests its own repository)
acceptance: From a named, clean committed-input worktree of a Git project other than the launcher installation, the installed standard launcher accepts an explicit project root for supported foreground focused Flutter and Dart test commands. The SDK runs in that worktree with its inherited project environment, and the registered run, equal complete source endpoints and owned reporter belong to that worktree and the original project claim.

Behaviour tests with separate launcher and target repositories prove that the supported command yields a settled native Test receipt for the target source through the existing owned Dart JSON reporter. Wrong project, original working directory or named worktree, an ineligible source, detached use, and altered request or reporter cannot yield a passing receipt. Existing repo-relative invocations keep their behavior. A run wait on an external --project-root lane run that reaches a terminal result without host launch custody ends with a named reason instead of following the record indefinitely, and a behaviour test covers a run wait whose launch association never arrives. External Test credit requires a measured clean launcher checkout, the verification record carries its observed commit and clean flag, and a dirty or unmeasurable launcher is refused with a named reason even when the run artifacts are valid.

With the landed implementation running on Central Windows and on Mac, use a native Codex-driven fit_friends session on each host to run the exact supported foreground standard launcher Flutter command from a separate clean fit_friends worktree prepared from origin/main, leaving the main checkout untouched. Use the synchronized fit_friends Engram project and store and the effective named source root. A passing Engram verification record of kind Test from the native registered run must exist in that store at the complete tested source. For each host, record the running build, launcher checkout commit and entry script path, exact command, run id, complete tested source, native verification receipt and original artifact locators, and state whether the whole suite or a selected scope ran. Record no environment values.
